verdict.rationale: Lambda documents an official Lambda Cloud API: REST endpoints for creating and managing resources, published with an OpenAPI spec at cloud.lambda.ai, plus programmatic instance launch with cloud-init. You can build against it with raw HTTP or OpenAPI-generated clients, but no official language SDK is evidenced, and the only CLI/MCP tooling is a community-built, unofficial project. Missing for 10: official language SDKs (e.g., Python/TypeScript), SDK documentation and examples, an official CLI, and independent corroboration of SDK use.
